main.title: Your 10-Step Path To A Beautiful Home
main.alt: Arrowhead Painting crew working on a two-story Kansas City home
steps: You Reach Out
Call us or request an estimate online. We'll get back to you within one business day.
We Call To Schedule Your Estimate
We find a time that works for you to meet at your home.
On-Site Estimate With You
We walk your property together, listen to your goals, and point out anything that needs attention.
Customized Written Quote
A clear, itemized proposal built around your home. No vague numbers and no surprise fees.
Color Consultation
Professional color guidance so you can choose with confidence.
Communication Leading Up To Your Project
Scheduling updates and a heads-up on weather or anything else that changes. You're never chasing us for an answer.
Pre-Job Walkthrough
Before work begins, we review the plan with you so everyone is on the same page.
Prep, Repairs & Painting
Our crew protects your home, preps meticulously, repairs what's needed, and paints with premium materials, with daily updates along the way.
Final Walkthrough
We review the finished work together. If anything isn't right, we take care of it before we call the job done.
Warranty
You receive your written warranty. We stand behind our work long after the ladders are gone.

exterior.title: Our Proven Exterior Painting Process
exterior.alt: Home with every seam and nail hole caulked, ready for paint
steps: Free On-Site Estimate & Inspection
We walk every side of your home with you, checking paint, caulk, and wood for problem areas.
Color Consultation
We help you choose colors that work with your roof, brick, and neighborhood.
Pre-Job Walkthrough
We review the plan, schedule, and any repairs with you before we start.
Protect Your Property
Plants, walkways, driveways, windows, and fixtures are covered and protected.
Power Wash
Every surface is washed so paint bonds properly and lasts longer.
Wood Rot Repair
Rotted siding, trim, fascia, and door frames are replaced with cedar, LP SmartSide, James Hardie, or PVC.
Scrape, Sand & Caulk
Loose paint is removed and every gap and seam is sealed against Kansas City weather.
Paint & Detail
Premium Sherwin-Williams coatings applied with care, from siding to the smallest piece of trim.
Final Walkthrough & Warranty
We review every side together, touch up anything you spot, and hand over your written warranty.

interior.title: Our Proven Interior Painting Process
interior.alt: Painters rolling walls in a two-story great room with floors protected
steps: Free In-Home Estimate
We walk through each room with you and talk through your goals, colors, and timeline.
Color Consultation
Professional guidance on colors and sheens so every room works together.
Protect Your Home
Furniture is moved and covered, floors are protected, and work areas are sealed off.
Surface Prep & Drywall Repair
Nail pops, cracks, and dings are patched and sanded for smooth, flawless walls.
Paint Ceilings, Walls & Trim
Clean lines and even coverage with premium Sherwin-Williams interior paint.
Daily Cleanup & Updates
Your home is left tidy at the end of every day, and you always know what's next.
Final Walkthrough & Warranty
We review every room together, touch up anything you spot, and provide your written warranty.

woodrot.title: Our Proven Wood Rot Repair & Carpentry Process
woodrot.alt: New siding installed on a two-story home after wood rot repair
steps: Inspect
We probe trim and siding and show you every soft spot we find.
Itemized Quote
Visible repairs are priced up front in your written estimate.
Remove Damaged Wood
Rotted material is cut back to solid wood. Find hidden damage? We show you photos before doing extra work.
Carpentry & New Material
Our carpenters install new boards in cedar, LP SmartSide, James Hardie, or PVC, matched to your home.
Seal & Caulk
Joints are sealed and flashed where needed so the new boards don't fail the same way.
Paint To Match
Repairs are painted to blend in with the rest of your home.

commercial.title: Our Commercial Painting Process
commercial.alt: Crew on ladders painting a large exterior
steps: Site Visit
We walk your property and learn how your business operates.
Detailed Proposal
A clear scope, schedule, and price for your project.
Schedule Around Your Business
Evenings, weekends, or phased work so your doors stay open.
Prep & Protect
Work areas are protected and kept safe for employees and customers.
Paint
Durable, professional-grade coatings applied efficiently and cleanly.
Walkthrough & Touch-Ups
We review the finished work with you and take care of any details.
